item.title: Zohran Mamdani Excuses Mob Attacking NYPD Officers With Snowballs As 'Kids,' Gets Roasted On Social Media
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is facing massive backlash after downplaying a mob pelting NYPD officers with snowballs and chasing them down as just "kids."

item.title: IIHF Boss Defends 3-On-3 Overtime Following Complaints After Gold Medal Game
item.description: Team USA’s Olympic gold in men’s hockey reignites controversy over 3-on-3 overtime, as IIHF defends the rule citing tournament logistics and packed Winter Games schedules.

item.title: Whataburger Manager Beat Attacker With A Trash Can After Employee Knocked Him Down With Fry Basket: WATCH
item.description: Stepping behind the counter at a restaurant and attacking an employee is asking for trouble. You're likely going to be outnumbered, and you're stepping onto their home turf.

item.title: Team USA's Brady Tkachuk, Matthew Tkachuk, And Connor Hellebuyck Talk Whirlwind Couple Of Days
item.description: After a whirlwind trip from Milan to the White House, Brady and Matthew Tkachuk and Connor Hellebuyck talked to Fox News' Bret Baier.

item.title: Boomer Esiason Shredded Team China’s Eileen Gu: Totally ‘Insufferable’
item.description: Boomer Esiason turned his attention to Eileen Gu, the American-born freestyle skier who chose to represent Team China in the Winter Olympics.

item.title: WATCH: 'Jeopardy!' Contestants Prove They Don't Watch Basketball By Failing Shai Gilgeous-Alexander Layup
item.description: For 800 bucks, "Jeopardy!" host Ken Jennings tossed up a photo of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander that should’ve been an absolute layup for anyone who has turned on a television in the last two years.

item.title: Biden's COVID Mandate Disaster Finally Ends As Coast Guard Members Are Reinstated By Trump Administration
item.description: President Trump and DHS Secretary Kristi Noem are correcting the shameful Biden-era vaccine mandates by reinstating 56 Coast Guard members with full back pay and benefits.

item.description: President Donald Trump turned the State of the Union address into something far bigger than a political event, showcasing that nothing captures the American spirit quite like a historic gold medal.

item.title: 'USA' Chants Break Out In House Chamber As US Men's Hockey Gold Medalists Attend Trump's State Of The Union
item.description: U.S. men’s hockey team players arrived in the House Chamber for President Donald Trump’s State of the Union speech to a joint session of Congress on Tuesday night.

item.title: Trump Says US Women's Hockey Team Will 'Soon' Visit White House After Declining SOTU Invitation
item.description: President Donald Trump said during his State of the Union address that the gold-medal-winning United States women’s ice hockey team will "soon" head to the White House to celebrate their victory in Milan.
